name: PallasMark – Video Proof & Buyer Approval for WooCommerce
author: pallasmark

sections.description:
Record what went into every WooCommerce package before it leaves your store. PallasMark adds a
proof layer to fulfillment: your team records the item, quantity, serial number, and visible
condition while packing, then keeps the video or photos linked to the order.

When a buyer reports a missing item, damage, or “item not as described,” you can open the order’s
timestamped proof instead of reconstructing the shipment from messages, screenshots, and CCTV.
PallasMark can also show the buyer what was packed and collect approval before a high-value or
custom order ships.

This is useful for high-value and fragile products, electronics, jewelry, custom orders, stores
with recurring returns disputes, and warehouses or 3PL teams that need a documented fulfillment
record.

How it works

  1. Install this plugin and connect your WooCommerce store to PallasMark.
  2. Orders arrive in PallasMark through WooCommerce webhooks, ready for your team to work on.
  3. Record the package while packing it. The proof is sealed with its order, timestamp, and
    verification history.
  4. Optionally send the buyer a private link to review and approve what was packed before shipment.
  5. Open the proof from the WooCommerce order screen when you need to handle a return, damage claim,
    wrong-item complaint, or chargeback dispute.

Features

  • Packing video and photo proof: document the item, quantity, serial number, and visible
    condition before dispatch.
  • Buyer approval before shipping: let a buyer review what was packed, or keep PallasMark in
    record-only mode.
  • Evidence linked to the order: open proof and return-evidence links from the WooCommerce order
    screen, including HPOS order screens.
  • Customer-facing proof status: show proof and return-evidence status on My Account → View order
    and the order-received screen. You can also use the [pallasmark_order_evidence] shortcode.
  • Webhook connection without manual copying: use a one-time connect token; the plugin creates
    the order.created and order.updated webhooks for you.
  • Webhook health controls: view topic, status, API version, and failure count, then safely
    re-register only the PallasMark webhooks.

Built for WooCommerce fulfillment teams

PallasMark is not a shipment-tracking or packing-slip plugin. It answers a different question:
what exactly was packed, and can you prove it later? Use it alongside your existing shipping,
tracking, inventory, and returns tools.

Learn more about the PallasMark WooCommerce integration
or see how packing video proof works.

Privacy and external service

PallasMark is a hosted service. This plugin communicates with the PallasMark URL configured in its
settings (by default, app.pallasmark.com) in two ways:

  • Automatic install ping: on activation, deactivation, and at most once every 24 hours while
    active, it sends only this site’s public URL and plugin, WordPress, and WooCommerce version
    numbers. It does not send order, customer, or product data in this ping.
  • Explicit store connection: when you paste a connect token and click Connect to PallasMark,
    the plugin exchanges the token and configures WooCommerce to send order-created and order-updated
    webhook payloads. Those payloads may contain customer, billing, shipping, product, and
    order-status data.

Deactivating or uninstalling the plugin stops the install ping. The webhooks created in WooCommerce
remain until you delete them or re-register them. See the PallasMark Privacy Policy
and Terms of Service.
sections.installation:
1. Install this plugin from the WordPress plugins screen, or upload the plugin folder to
    /wp-content/plugins/pallasmark-for-woocommerce.
  2. Activate it through the Plugins screen. Open WooCommerce → PallasMark.
  3. Click Log in to PallasMark. If you do not have an account, create one from the same screen
    with the 14-day Pro trial (no card required).
  4. In PallasMark, click Get connect token, copy the one-time token, and paste it into the
    WooCommerce settings page.
  5. Click Connect to PallasMark. The plugin registers the order webhooks automatically; no
    manual webhook secret copy-paste is required.
  6. Back in PallasMark, click Connect WooCommerce to grant read/write access for proof links
    and approval status on your orders.
sections.faq:
What is WooCommerce order proof?

WooCommerce order proof is a timestamped video or photo record of what your team packed, linked to
the order. It helps you respond to missing-item, damage, wrong-item, and “item not as described”
claims with evidence from the fulfillment step.

How do I record packing video proof for a WooCommerce order?

Connect your store, open the order in PallasMark, and record the package while you pack it. The
record is sealed and linked to the order, with a verification link you can open later.

Do I need a PallasMark account?

Yes, but you don’t need to create it separately first — click Log in to PallasMark on this
plugin’s settings page and you can sign up for a free account (14-day Pro trial, no card required)
right from there, with this store already attached.

Can buyers approve what was packed before shipping?

Yes. Buyer approval is optional. Send the buyer a private proof link and configure PallasMark to
hold the order until they approve, or use record-only mode without blocking shipment.

Can this help with a wrong-item, damaged-item, or missing-item dispute?

It gives you a record of the item and condition at packing time. Use the proof together with carrier,
delivery, and customer records when reviewing the claim.

Can I use PallasMark for returns and refund disputes?

Yes. PallasMark supports return-evidence workflows so you can request photos or video from the
buyer and keep the return evidence with the original order record.

Does this prevent chargebacks?

No service can guarantee that a chargeback will not be filed. PallasMark helps you prepare a
stronger, verifiable evidence file for shipment and “item not as described” disputes.

Does it work with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The WooCommerce order evidence panel supports High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Do proof links appear inside WooCommerce?

Yes. After the connection has write-back access, staff can open proof and return-evidence links from
the WooCommerce order screen. Stores can also show proof status to customers on My Account and the
order-received screen.

Is my order data sent anywhere else?

The plugin sends order webhook data only after you explicitly connect the store. Before that, the
automatic install ping contains only the store URL and software version numbers. PallasMark does not
send your data to a second service from this plugin.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

The install ping stops. Existing WooCommerce webhooks remain until you remove them or re-register
them, and your PallasMark account remains connected until you disconnect it there.

I previously used the “drProof” plugin — do I need to do anything?

Re-running Register webhooks on this version automatically removes any leftover webhooks from
the old plugin name and endpoint, and creates fresh ones pointed at the current PallasMark
endpoint.
sections.changelog:
1.0.11

  • Reworked the plugin listing around WooCommerce packing proof, order evidence,
    buyer approval, return evidence, and chargeback-dispute documentation.
  • Clarified the installation flow, WooCommerce order visibility, HPOS support,
    privacy disclosure, and common fulfillment questions.

1.0.10

  • Clarified that connect tokens expire after 10 minutes and can only be used once.
  • Added a specific message when a WooCommerce store is already connected to another
    PallasMark account.

1.0.9

  • Added a read-only PallasMark evidence panel to WooCommerce order screens, including HPOS.
  • Added proof and return-evidence status/links to WooCommerce customer order views and the
    order-received screen, with the [pallasmark_order_evidence] shortcode for custom placement.
  • Added ownership and order-key checks so customer-facing evidence links are not exposed to
    unrelated visitors.
  • Added webhook health visibility and a nonce-protected, idempotent re-register action.
